 By Aishwarya Samant Last Updated: Oct 27, 2026, 07:31 IST The IMD weather forecast for October 27 highlights Cyclone Arnab and potential rainfall across several states. Check the latest state-wise weather updates, rain alerts for Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, and the forecast for Delhi-NCR.
 IMD Weather Today: How Will Cyclone Arnab Affect Weather Across India? Check Rain Alerts For Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar And State-Wise Forecast 
 IMD Weather Forecast Today: The Indian weather department and government are closely monitoring the natural conditions that are swirling in the Bay of Bengal. 
 The cyclone Arnab is right now the pinpoint of concern. The Bay of Bengal is witnessing heightened cyclone activity as Arnab approaches the Andhra Pradesh coast. It is pushing several coastal areas in the west under the weather and alert radar. 
 The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy to extremely heavy rainfall in parts of Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Bihar and Uttar Pradesh. Cyclone Arnab is currently hovering over the west-central Bay of Bengal. Its position is right now roughly 350 km southeast of Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. 
 On the other hand, all in parts of Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Bihar and Uttar Pradesh. Meanwhile, Noida and Delhi-NCR are expected to enjoy mostly clear skies on October 27. The morning came with a cold atmosphere, marking the onset of winters. The temperature right in Delhi-NCR is roughly touching 30–31°C. 
 The weather may soon change, with rain, thunderstorms and gusty winds expected later this week. Residents are advised to stay alert and follow official IMD advisories before making any plans.
